about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of Spain: 17 autonomous communities and 2 autonomous cities, one region each. See docs/REGIONS-ES.md.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:ES community codes, ES-AN to ES-ML.
codes.why: Six of the 19 two-letter parts are US codes in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py): AR, CT, GA, MD, NC, RI. A bare ES is not a US code.
codes.verified: The ISO 3166-2 codes were not checked against the ISO site in this change.

addresses.notes: Release 2026-10-21.0: 15,627,615 rows; 15,627,066 with a five-digit postcode whose first two digits (01-52) are the province; address_levels holds only the municipality; postal_city empty; 44,667 without number and 308,341 with S-N.

addresses.notes: Not the Basque Country or Navarre.

pois.dataset: Registre de desfibril·ladors instal·lats a Catalunya fora de l'àmbit sanitari
pois.licence: see its Terms of Use (not read)
pois.notes: 12,853 rows with coordinates and opening hours.

not_open_nationwide: Postcode areas: Correos owns them; BOE-A-2023-11522 (opened) forbids CNIG from offering the postcode layer for download or to third parties

postal_code.format: Five digits; the first two are the province (01-52), so leading zeros are common (01xxx Álava, 08xxx Barcelona).

addressing.order: Street type, street name, number, then postcode and town ("Calle de Alcalá, 45, 28014 Madrid").
addressing.notes: normalize() and norm() keep only a-z and 0-9 ("Alcalá" becomes "alcal", "Peña" "pe a"); is_address_query() needs a number first; _parts() reads a postcode only as the last word; tools/build_addresses.py keeps only country = 'US', reads the state from address_levels[1] (the municipality in Spain) and the city from postal_city (empty in Spain). Overture writes streets in capitals, mostly without accents, with leading articles moved to the end ("CALLE CUEVAS LAS"). Checked in this repository and on Overture rows on 2026-11-17.
